messages:
kim_release: publishing window in ~10m for py/ts SDKs. plan: push canary -> smoke -> tag -> 2h hold -> final cut. include deprecation note for legacy sync clients. any blockers? @alex_devex @jordan_eng

alex_devex: on it. smoke scripts ready. propose pinning legacy sync to 0.9.x and publishing 1.0.0-rc for async clients. i'll add changelog and a short migration note.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled release job started: job_id r-20240615-002. will post statuses here.

jordan_eng: Quick check: if publish to PyPI/npm hits rate limits we fallback to staging artifacts and retry. rollback criteria: failing postpublish smoke or >3% integration failures in canary -> abort.

sam_sre: observability: enable debug traces for the first 30m and route canary traffic to the dedicated pool. i'll open #deploy-watch and keep an eye on 1-min error rates.

lee_docs: i'll draft the deprecation blurb. suggest short line + migration link. want wording before we push tags.

kim_release: copying the internal publish command here so it's explicit:
```
./scripts/publish.sh --packages python,typescript --tag canary --pin-legacy 0.9.x
```
waiting 7m, then running. if deploy-bot reports errors we pause and triage.

alex_devex: canary postpublish smoke commands (CI will run):
```
pytest tests/smoke_py::test_basic_import -k smoke
npm run test:smoke --workspace clients/ts
```
will kick those automatically.

deploy-bot: r-20240615-002: canary artifacts uploaded to staging. artifact URLs: https://artifacts.internal/r/20240615/py-canary.whl ; status: uploaded

kim_release: running publish... now.

deploy-bot: r-20240615-002: publishing py canary to PyPI (test) succeeded, main PyPI push queued. ts package publishing in progress.

alex_devex: smoke tests starting...

deploy-bot: r-20240615-002: smoke_py passed; smoke_ts failed (timeout fetching registry). marking partial failure.

jordan_eng: timeout looks like transient npm registry rate limiting. advice: wait 2m and retry TS publish. if second attempt fails, rollback PyPI and abort rollout.

kim_release: agreed. retrying TS publish in 90s.

deploy-bot: r-20240615-002: ts publish retry succeeded. smoke_ts passed. proceeding to tag release 1.0.0-rc (canary).

lee_docs: deprecation blurb ready: 'v1.0.0-rc introduces async-first clients; legacy sync clients will be maintained for security and critical bugfixes only and pinned at 0.9.x. Migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/migrate-sync-to-async'

sam_sre: monitoring live. no error spikes, latency within expected.

kim_release: tagging and releasing full packages now. we'll keep canary tag for 2h before cutting final release. if no regressions, cut final.

alex_devex: :thumbsup: preparing release notes draft and will add deprecation line.

deploy-bot: r-20240615-002: full release artifacts published, tag 1.0.0-rc created. rollout hold for 2h started.

jordan_eng: logging rollback criteria here: 1) critical import errors in >1% of Canary users 2) regression in core LLM calls for default prompts 3) package integrity mismatch on shasum. if any hit, revoke 1.0.0-rc and revert to pinned 0.9.x.

kim_release: copying the release note to #releases after we finalize wording. any final blockers? else i'll close window at +2h.

lee_docs: tiny nit: 'security fixes only' -> 'security and critical bugfixes only' — updated.

alex_devex: done. release notes pushed to draft in repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/releases/1.0.0-rc-draft

deploy-bot: r-20240615-002: 2h hold complete, no regressions observed. proceed to final release tag 1.0.0.

kim_release: final tag pushed. deprecation notice is live on docs site. closing thread — great work team :tada:
